topic: Hand off a real task: turn a pile of articles and notes into one clear report with Claude Cowork
post:
Got 12 browser tabs, 5 PDFs and a page of notes on the same topic? 📚
Let Claude Cowork turn them into one clear report.

Claude's own Cowork guide lists this as an example task: combining information from web searches, articles, papers and notes into coherent reports or summaries.

Step by step 👇
1️⃣ Save your articles, PDFs and notes into one folder
2️⃣ Open Claude and select Cowork in the message box
3️⃣ Share ONLY that folder
4️⃣ Paste the prompt below
5️⃣ Review Claude's plan, then let it run

Copy this prompt:
"Read everything in this folder and write a 2-page report called 'Research summary'. Include the 5 key findings, where the sources agree and disagree, and open questions. Cite which file each point came from. Don't change my original files."

Then check it ✅
Open 2 or 3 of the cited files and make sure the points really say what the report says.

📌 Cowork needs a paid plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise).

Why it matters:
The hard part of research isn't finding information. It's pulling it together. Now you can hand that part off. 💡

What topic would you research this way? 👇
